name: AniWorld Requests
description: Language-aware requests, movie/series destinations and owner-checked download deletion for H0melab Downloader.
overview: Search enabled sources, request the right language, route films and series to separate libraries, and manage your own downloads.
changelog: Requires Jellyfin 12.4 and H0melab Downloader 2.5.0. Requests are saved instantly and prepared in the background; full series fill every missing episode in the chosen language. Movies and series always go to the downloader's separate movie/show destinations. SerienStream and ZDF subtitles, all enabled downloader sources (including ZDF and DMAX), H0melab design and a prominent maintenance banner.
